# PassionCode.ai

> A toolkit for AI-native teams: an open-source workplace for AI agents. Fabric is the CEO AI agent; Fabric Switchboard, Fabric Dashboards, Fabric Inbox and Project Observatory are its tools, and each works on its own. Everything is open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0 and free to use; a commercial license and setup for companies are available.

Vision: do what you love — agents take the routine. You start from one command and your coding agent (Claude Code or Codex); the workplace runs on your own machines and grows with you.

## Languages
- Every page is published in English and in one more language, at the same path under the language's prefix: Russian (Русский) under /ru/ — for example https://passioncode.ai/ru/start/. Each page names all its versions with hreflang, English as x-default, and sitemap.xml lists every version. English is the source; where a translated privacy notice differs, the English version prevails.

## Start
- [Get started](https://passioncode.ai/start/): install the skills (`npx @passioncode-ai/passioncode@latest update`), add Fabric, create or convert an agent, run it in Fabric Dashboards, contribute.
- [Current releases as JSON](https://passioncode.ai/api/releases): every product's current version, release notes link, download URLs and SHA-256, resolved from GitHub releases.

## Products
- [Fabric](https://passioncode.ai/fabric/): the CEO AI agent; early preview for macOS on Apple silicon; keeps each project's purpose, board, decisions and releases. Its conversation does not reply yet.
- [Coding agents Fabric works with](https://passioncode.ai/fabric/agents/): which agents Fabric connects (Claude Code; Kilo Code and Hermes Agent in development), which run in it, which are planned.
- [Fabric Switchboard](https://passioncode.ai/switchboard/): local account manager for Claude Code and Codex CLI, macOS and Windows, with an MCP server (`switchboard mcp`); updates itself.
- [Switchboard agents](https://passioncode.ai/switchboard/agents/): 30 other coding agents (Hermes, Kilo Code, Cline, Goose …) get Switchboard's tools; those that accept a custom endpoint have their API-key accounts switched through it.
- [Fabric Dashboards](https://passioncode.ai/dashboards/): one window for local agent services that speak fabric-service/0.1; driven over MCP.
- [Project Observatory](https://passioncode.ai/observatory/): a local dashboard of project activity and findings with evidence; CLI, MCP and dashboard; macOS and Linux.
- [Fabric Inbox](https://passioncode.ai/inbox/): desktop mail for Gmail and Cloudflare mailboxes with agent reply policies; development preview.
- [Fabric Agent Adapter](https://github.com/passioncode-ai/fabric-agent-adapter): skills, kits and a conformance probe that make any agent, MCP server or CLI a Fabric-compatible service.

## Companies
- [For companies](https://passioncode.ai/business/): process mapping, a measured pilot, rollout and operation of an agent workplace; savings estimate = hours a week × 4.33 × share agents take (10–50% by how the work runs today) × loaded hourly cost.
- Contact: commercial@passioncode.ai
